observation.interpretation: No submission appeared in the selected group. The best public submission is not recorded here as an explicit manual final selection.

official_rules.scope: S6E11 rules permit up to two final submissions and define final submissions to include automatic Kaggle selection when the user has not selected them.

automatic_fallback.mechanism: Unfilled final-selection slots are filled from the highest public leaderboard submission scores.
automatic_fallback.condition: These are the automatic fallback candidates only if explicit selections, submission history, public scores and applicable rules remain unchanged until the competition closes.
automatic_fallback.source_scope: Kaggle Staff explanations of the general fallback mechanism; the S6E11 rules above establish this competition's two-slot limit and automatic-selection provision.
